title: Tallest Statue in the World | Statue of Unity - Laser Show | Gujarat, India.
description: Vlog # 204 Very informative and tiring day. We walked a lot at the tallest statue in the world. Worth a travel for all age group. Enjoy the video till end guys. Much love to all. Be kind to one another. Take care of your loved ones. Thank you everyone.   link to my second channel https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCIAkogDtJSIkoRwfvb39Eog  Vlogging camera https://amzn.to/2CZUECb Vlogging lens https://amzn.to/2D38wLZ Joby Gorillapod https://amzn.to/2AkKmvj Rode mic https://amzn.to/2ZpPln8 GoPro hero 7 https://amzn.to/38eLCwG Mobile | GoPro gimbal https://amzn.to/2VEan04 simplex led https://amzn.to/2YMrbEb iPhone https://amzn.to/3emcCxE lensball https://lensball.com   my twitter https://twitter.com/jaydeepdpatel_ my instagram https://www.instagram.com/jaydeepdpatel hazels instagram https://www.instagram.com/hezalnuts  if you are into wedding film making and photography please feel free to follow me on instagram @jdphotofilms  I live in Surat,Gujarat and love making vlogs, short movies editing.
